1.web: Hear this word that Yahweh has spoken against you, children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up out of the land of Egypt, saying:
1.asv: Hear this word that Jehovah hath spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up out of the land of Egypt, saying,

2.web: “You only have I chosen of all the families of the earth. Therefore I will punish you for all of your sins.”
2.asv: You only have I known of all the families of the earth: therefore I will visit upon you all your iniquities.

3.web: Do two walk together, unless they have agreed?
3.asv: Shall two walk together, except they have agreed?

4.web: Will a lion roar in the thicket, when he has no prey? Does a young lion cry out of his den, if he has caught nothing?
4.asv: Will a lion roar in the forest, when he hath no prey? will a young lion cry out of his den, if he have taken nothing?

5.web: Can a bird fall in a trap on the earth, where no snare is set for him? Does a snare spring up from the ground, when there is nothing to catch?
5.asv: Can a bird fall in a snare upon the earth, where no gin is set for him? shall a snare spring up from the ground, and have taken nothing at all?

6.web: Does the trumpet alarm sound in a city, without the people being afraid? Does evil happen to a city, and Yahweh hasn’t done it?
6.asv: Shall the trumpet be blown in a city, and the people not be afraid? shall evil befall a city, and Jehovah hath not done it?

7.web: Surely the Lord Yahweh will do nothing, unless he reveals his secret to his servants the prophets.
7.asv: Surely the Lord Jehovah will do nothing, except he reveal his secret unto his servants the prophets.

8.web: The lion has roared. Who will not fear? The Lord Yahweh has spoken. Who can but prophesy?
8.asv: The lion hath roared; who will not fear? The Lord Jehovah hath spoken; who can but prophesy?

9.web: Proclaim in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, “Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria, and see what unrest is in her, and what oppression is among them.”
9.asv: Publish ye in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria, and behold what great tumults are therein, and what oppressions in the midst thereof.

10.web: “Indeed they don’t know to do right,” says Yahweh, “Who hoard plunder and loot in their palaces.”
10.asv: For they know not to do right, saith Jehovah, who store up violence and robbery in their palaces.

11.web: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: “An adversary will overrun the land; and he will pull down your strongholds, and your fortresses will be plundered.”
11.asv: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: An adversary there shall be, even round about the land; and he shall bring down thy strength from thee, and thy palaces shall be plundered.

12.web: Thus says Yahweh: “As the shepherd rescues out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear, so shall the children of Israel be rescued who sit in Samaria on the corner of a couch, and on the silken cushions of a bed.”
12.asv: Thus saith Jehovah: As the shepherd rescueth out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear, so shall the children of Israel be rescued that sit in Samaria in the corner of a couch, and on the silken cushions of a bed.

13.web: “Listen, and testify against the house of Jacob,” says the Lord Yahweh, the God of Armies.
13.asv: Hear ye, and testify against the house of Jacob, saith the Lord Jehovah, the God of hosts.

14.web: “For in the day that I visit the transgressions of Israel on him, I will also visit the altars of Bethel; and the horns of the altar will be cut off, and fall to the ground.
14.asv: For in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Israel upon him, I will also visit the altars of Beth-el; and the horns of the altar shall be cut off, and fall to the ground.

15.web: I will strike the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory will perish, and the great houses will have an end,” says Yahweh.
15.asv: And I will smite the winter-house with the summer-house; and the houses of ivory shall perish, and the great houses shall have an end, saith Jehovah.
